whatIsHadoIntro: HADO is a new sport that uses AR (Augmented Reality) technology. Players wear a head-mounted display and an armband to fire virtual energy shots into the real world and compete against each other.
whatIsHadoFeature2: Enjoyable regardless of physical strength or age
whatIsHadoAppealDesc: HADO is a new form of entertainment that merges technology and sport. Team strategy and individual skill are both important, making it a deep experience that everyone from beginners to veterans can enjoy.
rulesBasic2: 80 seconds per game; in case of a tie, a 1-point player overtime is held
rulesBasic3: Reducing the opponent's life to 0 earns 1 point
rulesBasic4Item2: You cannot charge until you revive
rulesAttack1: Raising your arm 90 degrees charges your shot
rulesAttack2: You can store up to 5 charges
rulesAttack3: Thrusting your arm forward fires an energy shot
rulesAttack4: Energy shots fly in the direction the head device is facing
rulesAttack5: The speed and size of energy shots are determined by your stats
rulesDefense1: Lowering your arm charges your shield
rulesDefense2: With the shield charged, raising your arm deploys the shield
rulesDefense3: The direction of the shield is determined by the head device's facing
rulesDefense4: Shield charging takes 3 seconds. *The charge parameter does not affect this.
rulesDefense5: Shields let through allies' shots but block enemies' energy shots
rulesDefense6: Shields disappear when hit by an enemy energy shot or over time
rulesDefense7: The number and durability of shields are determined by the shield parameter
parametersBasic1: Each parameter can be allocated 1–5 points
parametersSpeedDesc: Movement speed increases with each parameter level.
parametersScaleDesc: The size of your energy shots increases with each parameter level.
parametersChargeDesc: The time required to charge 5 shots is reduced.
parametersShieldDesc: Shield durability and duration are improved.
parametersSource1: HADO Version Update and Parameter Adjustment Notice | HADO Official
rolesBasicDesc: In HADO, each player takes on a different role within the team to develop more effective strategies. It is important to choose roles that suit each player's strengths and preferences, while considering the overall team balance.
rolesAttackerFeature1: A role specialized in offensive power
rolesAttackerFeature2: Requires quick movement and accurate shooting
rolesAttackerFeature3: The main source of firepower for the team
rolesAttackerParam1: 5221: Speed-focused parameter. Can snipe from long range. Recommended for those good at aiming.
rolesAttackerParam2: 4321: A well-balanced parameter for an attacker
rolesAttackerParam3: 3421: Large shots make it powerful when you push forward to attack. Recommended for those who can move up front.
rolesAttackerParam4: 5311/4411/3511: Charge-1 attacker. Parameters focused on speed and scale. Can only fire 20 shots per match, but the power is overwhelming!
rolesDefenderFeature2: Knows when to use the offensive shield at the front of the court and the defensive shield at the back
rolesDefenderFeature3: Reads the team situation and protects teammates with low lives
rolesDefenderFeature4: Judges when to deploy shields based on remaining match time
rolesDefenderParam1: 1135: A parameter focused on shields – the quintessential tank setup
rolesDefenderParam2: 1144: A parameter that also prioritizes shield breaking, making shield deployment decisions even more critical
rolesChargerFeature1: A role specialized in charge speed
rolesChargerFeature2: Use your overwhelming number of shots to break the enemy's shields!
rolesChargerFeature3: Suppress and push back enemies who advance to attack!
rolesChargerParam2: 2251, 3151: Parameters focused on charge speed. The best shield-breaking performance. Beware of muscle soreness from over-swinging your arm.
rolesTechnicianParam1: 2521, 2431: Shots are large but slow, so coordinate aims with your team
